content: You who are compassionate toward sentient beings,You who intend for them to meet with happiness and part from suffering,You who intend for them never to be separated from joy,To you who intend their benefit and bliss, I prostrate.O Sage, definitively liberated from all obscurations,You who overwhelm the entire world with your splendor,Your wisdom pervades all that can be known;To you whose mind is liberated, I prostrate.Of all sentient beings,You tame every affliction without exception;To you who destroy afflictions, yet toward the afflictedRemain compassionate, I prostrate.Spontaneously accomplished and free from attachment,Unimpeded and always in meditative equipoise,You who provide the answer to every question,To you I prostrate.Regarding the support and the supported to be explained,And the speech and wisdom that explain them,Because your intellect is forever unimpeded,To you, the Excellent Teacher, I prostrate.Having departed, you know the conduct,And through their own languages, you knowThe coming, going, and definitive emergence of sentient beings;To you who give excellent instructions, I prostrate.Without grasping and without fault,Without turbidity and non-abiding,Unmoving regarding all phenomena—To you who are free from conceptual elaboration, I prostrate.Having attained all qualities to be acquired,You accomplish the activities for yourself and others;To you who see all knowable phenomenaWithout exception, I prostrate.Mindfulness, diligence, meditative concentration,Marvelous faculties and powers,The branches of enlightenment and the noble path—To you who have perfectly accomplished these, I prostrate.Through the nine meditative attainments that have abandonedThe conceptualizations belonging to the three realms,You have reached the consummation of the power to destroy mental hardness;To you, I prostrate.Completely empty of dualistic grasping,You have no yearning for appropriation;Because all signs are thoroughly pacified,To you who have attained the supreme liberation, I prostrate.Through having trained your mind for countless eonsIn primordial wisdom and compassion,You have perfectly subdued the hosts of MārasThat cause harm; to you, I prostrate.Regarding the outer, the inner, and both,And mastery over aspiration, knowledge, and instruction—To you who accomplish the affairs of the worldThrough these ten powers, I prostrate.Possessing marvelous, spontaneously accomplished qualities,Unimpeded regarding all that can be known,To you who have attained mastery over the meditative concentrationsOf accomplishment and relinquishment, I prostrate.You uphold the gateways of the Dharma,And through dhāraṇī, you easily revealAll phenomena in few words; to you who openThe treasury of Dharma, I prostrate.You have forever abandoned the stains,Such as attachment, that are difficult to avert,Along with the latencies that are the basisFor conceptualizing the three spheres; to you, liberated from all obscurations, I prostrate.Treasury of clear and stainless qualities,Through the support and the supported of enlightened activity,You possess the primordial wisdom of the ultimate nature;To you, the Perfect Buddha, I prostrate.Your voice is the lion’s roar of fearlessness,Endowed with the sixty branches of melody;To you who proclaim this excellentlyTo the entire world, including the gods, I prostrate.You have transformed the defiled stream of beingsThrough the truth of the path;To you, the Knower who has transformed itInto the wisdom that engages all beings, I prostrate.Having attained mastery over the endowmentsOf worldly beings, disciples, solitary realizers, and the supremeEndowments of the Teacher,To you, the Perfectly Endowed, I prostrate.Common and supreme qualities,Vast and most wonderful,To you, who have become the refugeOf the entire world, I prostrate.By this praise of the Teacher’s actual qualities,Who clarifies the precious teachings,May all beings clearly perceiveThe reality that is to be known.
